title: An admiral is waiting
line: Two fleets at dusk. Your opponent is an AI.

title: He studies every captain
line: His flagship, then his spyglass over your board: the Admiralty map is learned from every sealed board.

title: Brinewar
line: Naval battle against an AI admiral. Hide your fleet, hunt his.

title: Every shot is a transaction
line: Sealed boards and a Merkle proof for each answer. He can't cheat, and neither can you.

title: No wallet
line: No download and no sign-up: open the link and fire.

title: Victory
line: Sink him and his treasury pays the bounty.
